notes.title: German and Traditional Chinese update!
notes.content:
We're still in the middle of the summer sale but here is a new update: 
A TAVERN FOR TEA is now in German and Traditional Chinese!

Thanks to Antonio Moss (Toni Nerdson) for the German translation and sikv for the Traditional Chinese translation!

notes.title: quick fix: apple silicon support, text fixes, achievement sync update
notes.content:
🍵 a quick update to A TAVERN FOR TEA 🍵

- apple silicon should now be supported 
- fixed some issues with the spanish translation (thanks to Basajaun Games' Gabriel Fiallegas Medina!)
- fixed a typo in the english text
- updated achievement sync for players who played first on a different platform & then on steam

🌿 thank you for playing A TAVERN FOR TEA 🌿
